overview: The Medford City Council Committee of the Whole held its sixth preliminary budget meeting for Fiscal Year 2027 to review the elections, legislative, fire, and library department budgets. The committee debated various cuts and funding discrepancies and approved motions requesting revised figures and expenditure breakdowns for multiple departments.

items.title: FY 2027 Preliminary Budget: Elections Department
items.summary: Elections Director James Blatchford presented the Elections Department budget, detailing increases in election overtime for upcoming cycles and ongoing efforts to digitize the municipal census.

items.title: FY 2027 Preliminary Budget: Legislative Department
items.summary: The Council discussed the administration's proposed legislative budget, objecting to a 12 percent overall cut and the omission of funding for a charter-mandated council assistant position.

items.title: FY 2027 Preliminary Budget: Fire Department
items.summary: Approved a motion to request a breakdown of actual FY 2026 expenditures and FY 2027 projections for professional services following a presentation on the department's staffing shortages and high run volumes.

items.title: FY 2027 Preliminary Budget: Library Department
items.summary: Approved a motion to request an updated library budget reflecting a four-dollar hourly raise for part-time hourly staff to address pay equity concerns.

subject: FY 2027 Preliminary Budget Hearings
